sentences.text: The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — contains an incomplete yet three-dimensionally preserved skeleton featuring parts of the skull, spine, forelimb, and hindlimb.
Hyemin Jo discovered this fossil material in 2023 on Aphae Island in South Korea.

The genus name Doolysaurus honors a Korean cartoon character and the Ancient Greek word for lizard, while the species name huhmini commemorates paleontologist Min Huh for his work on Korean dinosaurs.
Phylogenetic analyses place Doolysaurus within the family Thescelosauridae, specifically in the subfamily Thescelosaurinae, classifying it as a thescelosaurid ornithischian dinosaur.
Doolysaurus lived during the Albian to lower Cenomanian stages of the Cretaceous period within the Ilseongsan Formation of South Korea.
Results of phylogenetic analyses vary depending on the dataset used, with some placing Doolysaurus in Orodrominae and others in Thescelosaurinae.
